2: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. Jehovah answer thee in the day of trouble; The name of the God of Jacob set thee up on high;
3: Send thee help from the sanctuary, And strengthen thee out of Zion;
4: Remember all thy offerings, And accept thy burnt-sacrifice; [Selah
5: Grant thee thy heart’s desire, And fulfil all thy counsel.
6: We will triumph in thy salvation, And in the name of our God we will set up our banners: Jehovah fulfil all thy petitions.
7: Now know I that Jehovah saveth his anointed; He will answer him from his holy heaven With the saving strength of his right hand.
8: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses; But we will make mention of the name of Jehovah our God.
9: They are bowed down and fallen; But we are risen, and stand upright.
10: Save, Jehovah: Let the King answer us when we call.
